title: Agent Lifecycle Agent Revision Register Response
description: ALR-1106 Route 1 response (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:564-577): the 201 first-registration or 200 exact-key-replay response for POST /api/v1beta/projects/{project_id}/agent-lifecycle/agent-revisions. Closed with exactly five properties. `record_ref` is new relative to the prior draft (closes Opus P1-1): minted atomically with `agent_revision_ref` in the same transaction, one-to-one -- each AgentRevision registration mints exactly one new record row and its own independent record_ref, never inferred from the row PK or from agent_revision_ref (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:570). It shares the same AgentLifecycleRecordRef shape as agent_lifecycle_record_response_schema.json's own record_ref -- both $ref agent_lifecycle_common_schema.json#/definitions/AgentLifecycleRecordRef rather than duplicating the shape (ALR-1106 also moved that definition there from the Route 5 file's prior local copy). identity_state uses the full common IdentityStateAxisValue (not narrowed the way Route 5's record-level axes are): the reserved VERIFIED branch is structurally valid in the common definition but service-invalid from this route because Part 1 has no producer for it (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:572, corpus case agent_revision_register_emits_reserved_verified_without_producer, service_invalid, out of this Schema-only corpus's scope). `StableOpaqueRef`/`TypedOpaqueRef`/`IdentityStateAxisValue`/`AgentLifecycleRecordRef` all live in agent_lifecycle_common_schema.json; this document $refs them cross-file rather than duplicating any shape. Every property below carries its own x-disclosure annotation at its own JSON Pointer (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:406-409, :434-437).

record_ref.description: kind=agent_lifecycle_record, server-random opaque id, version_id==id (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:570). Minted atomically with agent_revision_ref in the same transaction, one-to-one; never inferred from agent_revision_ref.

agent_ref.description: Resolved (existing or newly minted) logical Agent; no version_id (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:571).

identity_state.description: Per the two constructible Route 1 branches (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:557-560): client_declared mints RECONSTRUCTED/client_attested/[DECLARED_PROVENANCE]; omission mints UNKNOWN/client_attested/[REQUIRED_IDENTITY_UNKNOWN]. The reserved VERIFIED branch is structurally valid in the common definition but service-invalid from this route because Part 1 has no producer (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:572). ALR-1106 P1 fix (Terra review, 2026-08-10): allOf-wrapped rather than a bare $ref -- both forms validate identically, but a bare $ref was the exact shape the disclosure guard's original traversal bug failed to resolve; wrapping it removes the dependency on that bug being fixed to stay covered.
